tools.name: bazarr-badges
tools.description: Counts at a glance: episodes and movies wanting subtitles, providers throttled, announcements. Start here for 'how are subtitles doing'.

tools.name: bazarr-wanted-episodes
tools.description: Episodes still missing a subtitle in a wanted language, paged. sonarrSeriesId/sonarrEpisodeId link back to Sonarr.
tools.filter: {total, data: [.data[] | {sonarrSeriesId, sonarrEpisodeId, seriesTitle, episode_number, episodeTitle, missing: [.missing_subtitles[]? | .name]}]}

tools.name: bazarr-wanted-movies
tools.description: Movies still missing a subtitle in a wanted language, paged.

tools.name: bazarr-providers
tools.description: Subtitle providers with throttle state and reason (e.g. OpenSubtitles daily quota exhausted) and when they will be retried.

tools.name: bazarr-history-episodes
tools.description: Recent subtitle downloads/upgrades/failures for episodes, newest first.
tools.filter: {total, data: [.data[] | {timestamp, action, seriesTitle, episode_number, language: .language.name, provider, description}]}

tools.name: bazarr-history-movies
tools.description: Recent subtitle downloads/upgrades/failures for movies, newest first.
tools.filter: {total, data: [.data[] | {timestamp, action, title, language: .language.name, provider, description}]}

tools.name: bazarr-search-episode-subtitle
tools.description: Search providers and download the best subtitle for one episode in one language. Uses a provider quota. ids come from bazarr-wanted-episodes (sonarrSeriesId, sonarrEpisodeId).

tools.name: bazarr-system-health
tools.description: Bazarr health issues. Empty list = healthy.

tools.name: bazarr-system-status
tools.description: Bazarr version, Sonarr/Radarr versions it sees, OS and uptime.
